title: Chicken and vegetable noodle stir-fry
toddlerSplit: Take the toddlers' noodles and chicken out before the soy sauce reduces — theirs get a spoon of the cooking water and a drop of sesame oil. Snip their noodles short.
steps: Boil the noodles, drain, toss in a drop of oil so they do not weld together.
Very hot wok. Sliced chicken, 4 minutes, until coloured on all sides.
Add sliced pepper, broccoli and grated ginger, 3 minutes — keep it moving.
Add the noodles, toss to combine, then lift out the toddlers' portions.
Splash soy and honey into the wok, toss 1 minute until glossy, top with spring onions.
